desktopTools.frozen: Runs already started keep the setting they started with.
desktopTools.groupingWarning: Grouping exception: this workspace may hold a signed-in account in a desktop application and also browse untrusted sites. A Bot misled by page content can use that account. The owner accepted this risk for workspaces with desktop tools only (ADR-0048); it ends when desktop tools are turned off.
desktopTools.image.capable: The workspace image provides desktop tools.
desktopTools.image.not_capable: The workspace image does not provide desktop tools. An operator has to run the desktop image variant first.
desktopTools.image.unknown: Desktop tool availability could not be checked. Refresh; if it remains unknown, ask the person who runs Deskmates to check the workspace image.
desktopTools.intro: Native desktop tools let Bots work with applications on this workspace's shared desktop. They are on by default when the workspace image provides them; an Owner or Admin can turn them off for the workspace or for one Bot.
desktopTools.noApproval: Desktop actions run without asking for approval each time. What each call's code names is recorded in the run; that record is not a security boundary.
desktopTools.noBots: This workspace has no Bots yet.
desktopTools.strategyNote: Turning the tools on for a Bot changes how it works; compare it on paired runs before relying on it.
desktopTools.title: Desktop tools
